India (Qikink): { "sku_template": "UHd-{color}-{size}", "color_codes": { "Black": "Bk", "Grey": "Gm" }, "sizes": ["S","M"], "size_codes": { "2XL": "XXL" }, "print_type_id": 1, "designs": { "fr": { "width": 11.25, "height": 15 }, "bk": { "width": 11.25, "height": 15 } } }. Empty = not sold in India.
Sizes/colours: [{ "uid": "<Gelato UID>", "color": "Black", "size": "M", "markets": ["IN"] }]; "markets" only for a colour sold in some markets. Filled by scripts/add-products.mjs.

Per colour: { "Teal": { "photo": "<file id>", "mockup": "<file id>", "print_files": { "front": "<url>" }, "swatch": "#106E80", "note": "Regular fit" } }. A colour without files uses the product's. Filled by scripts/add-products.mjs.
Design per placement: { "front": "<url>", "back": "<url>", "sleeve-left": "<url>" }. Filled by scripts/add-products.mjs.
More photos (file ids), shown after the main photo and mockup of the first colour: ["<file id>", …]. Filled by scripts/add-products.mjs.

Specification on the product page: { "default": { "Fit": "Oversized", "Fabric": "…" }, "IN": { "Fabric": "…" } }; "IN" changes rows for India (Qikink's garments). A colour can add its own in colorways. Filled by scripts/add-products.mjs.
Price per currency: { "INR": 999, "USD": 39 }. India pays INR; the US, Canada, the UK and the UAE pay USD.
